package tech

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
)

// ListTechs lists techs with pagination.
type ListTechs struct {
	Techs repository.TechRepository
}

// Handle returns tech list.
func (uc ListTechs) Handle(ctx context.Context, filter filters.TechFilters) ([]domain.Tech, int, error) {
	return uc.Techs.List(ctx, filter)
}
